rate_limits: Published defaults: built-in email sends 2/hour project-wide; OTPs 30/hour; OTP/magic-link, signup-confirmation, and recovery resend windows 60 seconds/user; verification 360/hour/IP; token refresh 1,800/hour/IP; MFA challenge/verify 15/hour/IP; anonymous sign-ins 30/hour/IP. Some are configurable.
resolution_notes: rate_limits: Original is incorrect; current endpoint-specific quotas and token-bucket behavior are published at https://supabase.com/docs/guides/auth/rate-limits. example: Original placeholders are invalid; the official OpenAPI defines POST /signup, API-key security, email/password input, and the possible 200 user or token response at https://github.com/supabase/auth/blob/master/openapi.yaml. HTTP 0 for the templated base URL does not show an outage because YOUR_PROJECT_REF is not a real hostname.
